script.speaker: brooke
script.text: lunch crew is going downtown today! campus food has officially been conquered

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: also, meet roxy! she's from my climbing club. she said yes before i finished asking

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: hi!! new neighbourhood, new people. i'm down

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Welcome, Roxy. I've planned the route: bus from the north gate, then a short walk.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: love a plan. ok what are we eating

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: wait. i've never had vietnamese food. let's do viet!!

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: viet sounds great. i'm in, as long as it's the healthy kind, nothing greasy

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Viet works for me. Roxy, since you're new: I'm allergic to peanuts. No peanut sauce, no crushed peanuts on top.

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: peanut-free, always. a lot of viet dishes use them, so we check

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: noted!! zero peanuts. i'll guard your plate

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ooh and i'm getting one of those iced coffees with the sweet condensed milk. let's do it

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: oh no. right. dairy and me are not friends

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok so nothing with milk, cream or butter for me. i always forget until it's too late

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Good catch, Brooke. Better to know now than on the bus home.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: adventure is still ON. assistant, find us something. let's go!!
